CAL.NOT: familywise global calibration (requires all families, both systems, family prior integration, n_pseudo >= 2000 or precision stopping; Phase B/C engine)
CAL.event: Event B with 2D pseudo thresholds (T1 <= T1_pseudo and T2 <= T2_pseudo)
CAL.method: sorted-T1 searchsorted + per-cluster counts; one shared cluster-resampling matrix (B x K) for every pseudo; Q lower CI = 2.5% percentile; D = KDE point estimate (fitting subsample separate from evaluation)

positive_control.density_ratio: log-space (gaussian_kde.logpdf); v1.2.8 Colab official failed the control inventory because the boosted-KDE pdf underflowed to 0 at far-tail pseudo thresholds
positive_control.note: at central pseudo thresholds the ratio is capped by 1/P_iso, so the control is evaluated at the observed (tail) thresholds
positive_control.construction: isotropic sample with T1 and T2 scaled by 0.35 (synthetic boosted Event B), same clusters

sensitivity_float32_selection.scope: CONDITIONAL: primary (float64) pseudo thresholds held fixed; model/isotropic hit tables, Q lower CI, D and support recomputed from the float32-selected outputs (same clusters)
